register_sharded_tensor_properties: register tensor properties like shape, dtype, layout, size, dim, ndim, is_contiguous, is_floating_point as sharded ops
test_sharded_tensor_device: test the sharded tensor device property returns the local shard's device or gloo cpu device
build_sharded_type_as: build a sharded tensor type_as operation that casts all local shards to match a target tensor's dtype
create_sharded_deepcopy: create a sharded tensor deepcopy that deep copies local shards and metadata without copying the process group
test_sharded_clone: test the sharded tensor clone operation that clones each local shard with preserved memory format
refactor_sharded_detach: refactor the sharded tensor detach operation that detaches each local shard and sets requires_grad to false
summarize_inplace_copy: summarize the sharded tensor inplace copy operation that validates matching metadata before copying shard tensors
